description: What one mission-pack operation does to a pack's items, as frontend/src/feature/missionPacks/packOps.js does it (the reference). `items` maps an item's uuid to {kind, name, data, deleted}; `op` is what a client sends (or, for item.replace, what the server writes); `status` is applied, skipped or invalid, with `reason` for the last two; `expected` is the items afterwards, equal to `items` unless the operation was applied. See docs/MISSION_PACKS.md.
